title: Small-block Chevy hydraulic lifter preload (valve adjustment)
tools: Breaker bar or remote starter to turn engine
steps: Remove the valve covers. Rotate the engine to TDC on the #1 compression stroke (timing mark at 0, rotor pointing at #1 tower).
At #1 TDC adjust: exhaust valves 1, 3, 4, 8 and intake valves 1, 2, 5, 7.
For each: loosen the rocker nut until there is up-and-down play in the pushrod. Tighten slowly while spinning the pushrod with your fingers until you feel slight resistance. That is zero lash.
From zero lash, turn the nut 1/2 turn more (stock hydraulic preload). Some performance lifters call for 1/4 turn, so follow the lifter maker.
Rotate the crank one full turn (360 degrees) to TDC on #6.
Reinstall the valve covers with new gaskets. Start and listen. A light tick that fades in a minute is normal while lifters pump up.
